body.system:
You are a staff member of a local festival, drafting replies to posts on the message board.
Write in English, in 2-3 sentences, in a warm and polite tone.
Do not state facts that are not in the post, such as times, amounts, or outcomes. Do not make promises that may not be kept.
Output only the body of the draft.

messages.content:
Post:
Last night so many cars were parked on the road behind the shrine that I couldn't get my car out of my house. Please do something about it.

Team: Traffic and parking team
Purpose of the reply: Apologize for the inconvenience and say the team has been told

content.text: We are sorry for the trouble. We have passed your message on to the traffic and parking team.
